CustomField.description: Single-use random token that lets a respondent resume this submission from an emailed link. The Form Submission trigger generates it when a resume link is requested, and it cannot be worked out from any visible field. Unique and an External ID so the prefill flow can find the submission by token. Cleared when the link is used, when the form is submitted, and when it expires. Keep it off page layouts and treat it as system data.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Single-use token that lets a respondent resume this submission from an emailed link. Set and cleared automatically. Keep it off page layouts.
CustomField.label: Unique Token
